title: Microsoft DAX, Power BI Semantic Model, Power Pivot, and Tabular Model Documentation

sources.notes: Official DAX overview defining DAX across Analysis Services, Power BI, and Power Pivot, including measures, calculated columns, calculated tables, row-level security, and queries.
Official DAX reference landing page for functions, operators, and expressions used in Power BI, Analysis Services, and Power Pivot tabular data models.

Official Power BI guidance connecting semantic model design to star schemas, dimension tables, fact tables, grain, relationships, SCDs, role-playing dimensions, junk dimensions, degenerate dimensions, and factless facts.
Official Power BI relationship guidance covering filter propagation, relationship cardinality, star schema principles, disconnected tables, and relationship properties.
Official Power BI measures guidance for DAX measures, report-level measures, dynamic context, organization, and data categories.
Official Analysis Services Tabular overview covering in-memory and DirectQuery tabular models, VertiPaq, semantic model objects, tables, partitions, relationships, hierarchies, measures, and KPIs.

Microsoft Support Power Pivot overview for Excel Data Model, relationships, calculations, Power Query, and DAX; support-page prose, images, and tutorials remain metadata-only pending support-site terms review.
Public Power BI Desktop installer and sample/download surfaces can be locally cached only after download, license, security, and redistribution review; internal Microsoft assets are not mapped.

Official DAX function reference covering aggregation, date/time, filter, financial, INFO, information, logical, math/trig, parent-child, relationship, statistical, table manipulation, text, and time intelligence functions.
Official DAX syntax reference covering expressions, table/column references, naming rules, measures, columns, reserved keywords, and special characters.
Official DAX operator reference for arithmetic, comparison, text concatenation, logical operators, IN, precedence, parentheses, and type coercion.
Official DAX query reference covering EVALUATE, ORDER BY, START AT, DEFINE, MEASURE, VAR, TABLE, COLUMN, DAX query view, and external query tools.
Official DAX variables best-practice article for performance, readability, debugging, and reducing complexity.
Official Power BI DAX guidance recommending Boolean filter arguments for CALCULATE/CALCULATETABLE when possible, with FILTER reserved for complex cases.

SQLBI DAX Guide source identity for curated DAX functions, operators, statements, data types, compatibility matrices, and row/filter/context-transition attributes; content remains metadata-only pending SQLBI terms review.
SQLBI DAX Patterns source identity for reusable business-calculation patterns, especially time intelligence; pattern bodies remain metadata-only pending SQLBI terms review.
DAX Studio source identity for DAX query and performance tooling; docs, binaries, examples, and traces remain boundary-checked pending terms and file review.
